content.text:
I checked the letter's performance section against the fact sheet's performance table.

**Finding:** The letter reports four of the five performance figures — Q2 net (-3.36%), Q2 gross (-3.16%), the comparison index (-2.95%), and trailing 12 months (6.18%). The year-to-date net return of 0.92% appears nowhere in the letter.

Worth flagging: the letter's phrase "Over the past year, your mandate has delivered 6.18% net of fees" correctly maps to the trailing 12-month figure, so it is not a mislabeled YTD number — it is an accurate statement of a different measure. The YTD figure is simply omitted rather than distorted. That omission is notable given the context: 0.92% is the only positive year-to-date number available, and its absence leaves a letter whose headline figures are all negative for the quarter, which may matter for the tone note about Samuel's skepticism.
